data.name: Khair
data.gender_notes: Khair is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'khayr' which means 'goodness' or 'blessing'. The name Khair carries the meaning “Generous, Benevolent” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khair usually hope their child will grow to embody generous, benevolent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name mentioned in Surah Al-Fatiha, emphasizing the importance of doing good and being kind to others.
data.etymology: Khair belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Generous, Benevolent.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khair total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: خیر
in_arabic.long_meaning: الخيرُ حَسَنُ الخَلقِ، وَالجَمالُ مِن سِجِلِّ اللَهِ، والأمانةُ مِن تَمامِ اللَياليِ، والصِدقُ مِن حِقابِ اللَهِ. فَاِستَعِدِ الخَيرَ وَتَصَدّقْ بِاللَهِ، وَاِرتَفِعْ بِالعَفافِ، وَاِرتَقي بِالعَفوِ، وَاِرتَقي بِالرِقابَةِ.

in_urdu.name: خیر
in_urdu.meaning: خیر ہر نیک کام اور نیک اعمال کا نام ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: خیر کا مفہوم نیک اعمال اور نیک کاموں کا ہے۔ اللہ تعالیٰ کے فرمان میں یہ کہا گیا ہے: "خیر سے کھانا کھانے والا نیک کام کرتا ہے اور اللہ تعالیٰ سے ڈرنا بھی اچھا ہے"۔

in_hindi.name: खैर
in_hindi.meaning: खैर अच्छे काम और अच्छे व्यवहार का नाम है
in_hindi.long_meaning: खैर अच्छे काम और अच्छे व्यवहार के लिए उपयुक्त है। इस्लामिक परंपरा में यह माना जाता है कि अच्छे काम करने वाले लोग अच्छे परिणाम प्राप्त करते हैं।

In many Muslim communities, the name is given to children as a reminder to strive for goodness and to make a positive impact on the world around them.

It is believed that invoking the name of God as 'Khair' brings a sense of blessings and protection. In Islamic spirituality, seeking 'khayr' or goodness, is considered to be a fundamental aspect of drawing closer to Allah and living a spiritually fulfilling life. The name is also used in various Islamic prayers and duas, seeking Allah's guidance and blessings. Ultimately, the name "Khair" is a constant reminder of the importance of living a good and virtuous life, both in this world and the hereafter.
